description: This Python source file contains functions for analyzing Robot Framework test schemas, extracting required variables from .robot files, and handling keyword and variable parsing logic.

methods.name: _normalize_var
methods.description: Normalizes variable names by stripping whitespace.

methods.name: _extract_vars_from_text
methods.description: Extracts variable references from text using regex.

methods.name: _is_assignment_token
methods.description: Checks if a token represents a variable assignment.

methods.name: _assigned_vars
methods.description: Extracts variables assigned within a keyword definition.

methods.name: _extract_file_level_variables
methods.description: Extracts variables defined in the Variables section of the robot file.

methods.name: _build_keyword_map
methods.description: Builds a map of keyword names to their definitions.

methods.name: _find_best_keyword_match
methods.description: Finds the best matching keyword definition for a call.

methods.name: _process_keywords
methods.description: Recursively processes keywords in a test case to extract used variables.

methods.name: _cleanup_candidates
methods.description: Removes built-in, system, file-level, and assigned variables from candidates.

methods.name: get_required_variables_for_case
methods.description: Analyzes a robot test file to extract required variables for a specific test case.
